mapper.insert: insert into diet_record (user_id, dish_id, dish_name, record_date, meal_type, calorie, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sodium, source, order_item_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{recordDate}, #{mealType}, #{calorie}, #{protein}, #{fat}, #{carbohydrate}, #{sodium}, #{source}, #{orderItemId}, #{createTime})

insert into diet_record (user_id, dish_id, dish_name, record_date, meal_type, calorie, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sodium, source, order_item_id, create_time) values
(#{r.userId}, #{r.dishId}, #{r.dishName}, #{r.recordDate}, #{r.mealType}, #{r.calorie}, #{r.protein}, #{r.fat}, #{r.carbohydrate}, #{r.sodium}, #{r.source}, #{r.orderItemId}, #{r.createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from diet_record where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and source = 'manual'
mapper.select: select id, user_id, dish_id, dish_name, record_date, meal_type, calorie, protein, fat, carbohydrate, sodium, source, order_item_id, create_time from diet_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_date = #{date} order by id asc

select #{date} as date, ifnull(sum(calorie), 0) as calorie, ifnull(sum(protein), 0) as protein, ifnull(sum(fat), 0) as fat, ifnull(sum(carbohydrate), 0) as carbohydrate, ifnull(sum(sodium), 0) as sodium, count(*) as recordCount from diet_record where user_id = #{userId} and record_date = #{date}
